title: Acme Mutual claims: cloud design
subtitle: What the platform runs on, on Azure and on AWS, and what it costs.

verdict.text: Azure, on Kubernetes, with PostgreSQL; backups stored in the cheapest archive tier in West US 2.

blocks.text: Two node pools on Kubernetes keep the application and the batch work apart. The database is managed PostgreSQL. Backups go to a low-cost archive tier in West US 2.
